tex_only_changes: Superseded: the author requested a wording clarification after the Overleaf teacher edit; all quantitative claims remain unchanged.
heldout_scope: Paired post-learning PushObj unseen shapes and PushT six visual shifts; both GD and CEM. Not the online PushObj main-table row or the seven-condition visual All rate.
cd_scope: Fourth-pass main-table slow predictor versus pretrained DINO-WM on the matched 50-instance stream.

task_specific_results_revision.wording: SE-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art planning performance, improving held-out success over AdaJEPA by 15.4--17.1 percentage points on unseen PushObj shapes and 15.9--18.7 points on PushT visual shifts across both planners. On rope and granular manipulation, Chamfer distance drops by 48.6\% and 26.7\%, respectively, relative to pretrained DINO-WM. Performance improves further over repeated deployment.
task_specific_results_revision.success_metric: Absolute percentage-point gain over official-checkpoint AdaJEPA on paired held-out evaluations. Each range spans CEM (lower) and GD (upper).
task_specific_results_revision.cd_metric: Relative reduction versus pretrained DINO-WM, from unrounded fourth-pass mean CD on the repeated 50-instance streams. Kept separate from the held-out success comparison.
